title: OpenAI gpt-5 family catalog conventions: (1) gpt-5.4 and lat...
content:
OpenAI gpt-5 family catalog conventions: (1) gpt-5.4 and later subsume the `-codex` suffix — there is no gpt-5.4-codex or gpt-5.5-codex; the flagship model is codex-optimized by default. Earlier generations (5.1, 5.2, 5.3) still have distinct `-codex` variants. (2) xhigh reasoning effort is supported on gpt-5.4, gpt-5.5, gpt-5.1-codex-max, and gpt-5.2-codex — not restricted to the codex-suffixed models. (3) The `codex exec -m <id>` error `"<id> is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account"` is NOT proof that the model exists — OpenAI returns this for arbitrary unknown IDs when auth is ChatGPT-plan, so it cannot be used as existence verification. Confirmed 2026-04-23 during CODEX_MODELS update for gpt-5.5.</content>
